title: Teen Patti
desc: Mathematician Perci Trachtenberg meets Venkat, a genius whose probability theory pulls him into the dark, tempting world of gambling, where brilliance meets greed, risk, and unexpected consequences.

title: Vijay The Master
desc: An alcoholic professor starts teaching at a juvenile centre without knowing. He soon clashes with a gangster who uses the kids to do his dirty work.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Sam Bahadur
desc: Sam Manekshaw, one of India's most decorated army officers, served for over four decades, fought five wars, and became the first Indian officer to be promoted to Field Marshal.

title: Lal Salaam
desc: Talented aspiring cricketers, unfairly dropped from the game, battle rejection and setbacks. Refusing to quit, they push through obstacles with grit to reclaim their dreams.

title: KA
desc: Abhinaya Vasudev wakes up amnesiac in a high-security interrogation cell, where a mysterious interrogator uses hypnosis to uncover his past and expose a trail of roguish deeds.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Suraj Pe Mangal Bhari
desc: Suraj, an eligible bachelor, faces repeated rejections from prospective brides' families, only to discover that a wedding detective, Madhu Mangal Rane, is secretly behind his misfortunes.

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Jodi No.1
desc: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when both of them fall for his daughters.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: The Hero: Love Story Of A Spy
desc: Arun, an Indian spy, falls for Reshma. When she disappears during a mission, he vows revenge and sets out to punish those responsible.

title: Race
desc: Two stepbrothers run a lavish stud farm and horse racing empire. When they fall for the same woman, jealousy turns deadly-one plots murder to claim love and insurance money.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Commando - A One Man Army
desc: Karan, an Indian commando, is arrested by Chinese officials after a crash. Accused of spying, he must escape from their tough prison camp using all his skills.
